ctx.x: When we came back to Paris at the end of May, Willie didn't have a job for us to go on until [Knokke] the middle of July in Knocke. Oscar Aleman was the leader of an orchestra in a dancing hall on Rue Fontaine. "Spider" Courance had left the Villa d'Este where he had continued to work after I left there to join Willie Lewis. Oscar asked me if I would care to work with him until time for me to go to Belgium and although I didn't care for the type of music Oscar was playing as it was mostly Latin-American music, I…

Valada Snow, the third woman that I had heard play trumpet, was in Paris working as an attraction in some club and the manager of the also hired her to come in and do an attraction for 20 minutes. When I first heard Valada and I was an amateur horn man, she was waiting, but
now it seemed as though she had lost something although she still blew strong.
